confirmed.summary: FR-004's '4 static cases minimum' was unreachable under its own '1 skill' wording and inconsistent with the Scope Guard's 2x2 ceiling
confirmed.recommendation: Lower FR-004's floor to 2 cases (2 personas x 1 skill) and reframe the Scope Guard's 2x2 figure as a ceiling, not a floor.

confirmed.summary: Projector (FR-001) silently dropped the profile's initialization-declaration and purpose fields -- its most instruction-dense, contradiction-relevant content -- without disclosing the omission in FR-002's fidelity-loss table
confirmed.recommendation: Fold initialization-declaration + purpose into FR-001's body mapping; keep the fidelity-loss table limited to fields with no RFC-1 body slot at all.

confirmed.summary: SOP policy-extract drift check was asserted in Key Entities/OQ-6 prose but had no FR, verification command, or falsification test
confirmed.recommendation: Add a dedicated FR (mirroring FR-003's persona drift-gate pattern) with its own verification command and falsification test.

confirmed.summary: AC-4's baseline-validity-guard citation (rule-survival.ts:435-475) pointed at checkDiscriminationControl/buildPrecedenceObservation, not the actual BASELINE_THRESHOLD guard
confirmed.recommendation: Correct to rule-survival.ts:537-601 (BASELINE_THRESHOLD at 540, guard branch at 587).

confirmed.summary: Cadence job's trigger mechanism and CI secret provisioning for MUSTER_ENDPOINT/MUSTER_API_KEY were unspecified
confirmed.recommendation: Add trigger (schedule + workflow_dispatch) and repository-secrets provisioning language to FR-005.

confirmed.summary: FR-006's 'delete the rigged case' falsification direction only proves 'no case -> no finding', not that the finding was caused by the case's content -- this fork's own commit 0b1cf9b8a already had to fix an equivalent hollowed-control vacuous-pass defect
confirmed.recommendation: Replace the delete direction with a neutralization direction: same case structure (layer count/types, no precedence block), contradictory text replaced by benign text, confirm the finding disappears.

confirmed.summary: Every bare 'npx --offline @garrison-hq/muster@1.1.0 ...' verification command would fail on a cold cache/runner -- this fork's own conformance/README.md documents the two-step cache-warm-then-offline requirement, and CI already avoids the trap via muster-action
confirmed.recommendation: Add an explicit cache-warm dependency note covering all verification commands, and specify that crosslayer.yml uses garrison-hq/muster-action the same way conformance.yml does.

confirmed.summary: C-003's example grep pattern (bracket-index shape) had no established connection to how fabricated fields would actually appear in prose/YAML, both false-negative- and false-positive-prone
confirmed.recommendation: Tighten to field-name-keyed patterns and be explicit the constraint is a review-time textual audit, not a fully machine-checkable gate.

confirmed.summary: FR-002's verification only checked that two headings existed, satisfiable by two blank stub sections
confirmed.recommendation: Assert on the actual required field names appearing under the Fidelity Loss heading, not merely heading presence.

confirmed.summary: Same rule-survival.ts:435-475 mis-citation independently found by the architect lens
C-002's prose ('conformance/** plus workflow file') omitted kitty-specs/**, which its own verification command allow-listed
confirmed.recommendation: Update C-002's statement to name kitty-specs/** explicitly.

confirmed.summary: FR-006's original verification piped muster's output into jq -e and reported jq's exit code as the pass signal, never actually checking muster's own exit code that AC-3 claims
confirmed.recommendation: Capture muster's exit code separately from the jq assertion so both are independently verified.
